Chapter 6530: Second Immortal Ascension

Chapter 6530: Second Immortal Ascension

Desolate Ancestor and Zhan Sansheng had an irreconcilable feud, whether he was Moshi, Dingtian, or Poye.

Although the tree eluded all cultivators, rumor has it Desolate Ancestor and Life-and-death Heaven were responsible for its protection.

Poye tried to burn the tree and this started the earthshattering Nightwatch War. Thus, how could his opponents allow him to be reborn at the tree?

***

A big shot from Supreme Heaven asked his senior: “The ancestor is really coming back at the tree?”

“How the hell do I know?” The senior had no idea.

In history, the rebirth of their ancestor was the highest secret. They themselves didn’t know, let alone outsiders.

Perhaps only Weizhen had an answer but he never told anyone.

“Is it fake news?” Some emperors and desolate gods wondered.

“Xian Chengtian might be a bastard but he wouldn’t do this, nor does he need to.” A powerful emperor said.

Besides the betrayal, he still had the trust of Supreme Heaven and two redemption grounds.

“Wouldn’t this antagonize Supreme Heaven?” A desolate god wondered since this might be the most crucial piece of information in their world.

“What is his goal?” A primal ancestor felt confused.

Amidst the confusion, a second mantra became clear from Celestial City and poured down like a river.

“Two redemption grounds have avatars. Shed the self and ascend to immortality once more.” This message echoed across Heaven World.

“What?!” All regions were shocked to hear this.

“Avatars?” Supreme overlords wanted to know the avatars’ identity.

“What are they trying to do?” An emperor wondered.

“Supreme Heaven must have known.” Another top cultivator said.

These two redemption grounds had a strong relationship with Supreme Heaven since the start of Immortals Slaughtered.

“News to me.” A primal ancestor from Supreme Heaven was speechless.

“Ancestor Weizhen might be aware.” Another speculated.

However, Weizhen was in isolated cultivation and rarely appeared. Junior primal ancestors didn’t have the opportunity to see him.

“Shed the self and ascend?” Supreme overlords wondered about this line.

“There’s an issue here, perhaps trickery.” Overlords in Life-and-death Heaven wondered.

Currently, the ancient immortals in the redemption grounds stood at the apex, unkillable even by Desolate Ancestor and Zhan Sansheng.

They were stronger than other immortals and exceeded the overlords’ imagination. With that in mind, why would they abandon the self and ascend again? This whole thing didn’t make sense.

The big shots tried to find proof to no avail. The redemption grounds didn’t react to this revelation.

A third mantra appeared and interrupted their plans again.

“Bao Pu consumed an immortal corpse and is an immortal now, hiding in Corpse Wasteland.”

This overwhelmed people more than the first two pieces of information.

“Impossible!” Emperors and progenitors who had lived in the ancient era couldn’t believe it.

“Bao Pu died in battle long ago.” Progenitors close to him refused to believe this.

“It’s nonsense, Bao Pu is dead.” An emperor wanted to defend Bao Pu.

“Which immortal corpse?” Many questions came from this.

“Only the three immortals...” The elder progenitors shuddered upon hearing this.

“I thought Bao Pu was close to them.” One progenitor said.

“Maybe not the three immortals. There were other fights before our time, maybe from then.” Those who had a high opinion of Bao Pu said.

“This is a smokescreen from Xian Chengtian.” Another said.

“Why would he do this and risk antagonizing his allies?” Others disagreed.

“So it’s true.” Some from Life-and-death Heaven had heard rumors of this before. This confirmed their speculation.

“Hiding in Corpse Wasteland.” Supreme overlords gazed in this region’s direction.
